ValidationRule.description: Date Term Quote Attempt 2 must be today's date. It cannot be in the Past or the Future. For reference, check user story #26355 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (RecordType_Name__c = "CLAS - RM") && OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(Cost_Summary_Attempt2__c) && NOT(ISBLANK(Cost_Summary_Attempt2__c)) && DATEVALUE(Cost_Summary_Attempt2__c) != TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Cost_Summary_Attempt2__c)) || DATEVALUE(Cost_Summary_Attempt2__c) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Cost_Summary_Attempt2__c)) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(Cost_Summary_Attempt2__c)) && DATEVALUE(Cost_Summary_Attempt2__c) != TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Date Term Quote Attempt 2 must be today's date. It cannot be in the Past or the Future.
